significati.essoterico: Hope, renewal, inspiration. It points to healing after a crisis, trust in the future and unexpected help.
significati.psicologico: The ability to reconnect with a wider vision; the trust that is born from having crossed the dark.
significati.iniziatico: Path 28 from Netzach to Yesod, the letter He (the window, 5) and Aquarius, fixed air: the window from which infinity can be glimpsed. Nuit pours out the waters of life and reminds us that every man and every woman is a star.
significati.ombra: Ill-dignified, it signals illusion, disappointment, sterile idealism, hopes that have no roots.

dritto: Well-founded hope and inspiration: the direction is right. A time of healing, renewal and trust.
rovescio: Trust lost, vision clouded; you need to find your way back to your most authentic ideals.

ambiti.amore: Sincere love, openness and mutual trust; the healing of emotional wounds.
ambiti.lavoro: Inspiration, creativity, long-term vision; future-oriented projects.
ambiti.spirito: Recognising yourself as a star: divine individuality in an infinite cosmos.

nota_crowley: Following the correction 'Tzaddi is not the Star', Crowley assigns the letter He to the Star; the figure is Nuit pouring water from two cups, one of gold and one of silver, beneath the seven-pointed star of Babalon.
